input_oneliner: 58M alcohol cirrhosis admitted yesterday for ascites, last drink 3 weeks ago per family, tonight somnolent, oriented to person only, HR 78, afebrile

reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Asterixis with depressed arousal in cirrhosis supports hepatic encephalopathy
Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis is the commonest precipitant and can be nearly silent; tenderness on exam prompts paracentesis
Reported melena carries a high LR for upper GI bleeding, a treatable precipitant of encephalopathy
Melena on examination has a very high LR for upper GI bleeding and does not depend on a reliable history in a somnolent patient

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about constipation, last bowel movement, and lactulose doses
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Constipation and missed lactulose are the commonest correctable precipitants

reference_targets_freetext.item: Medication review (MAR): benzodiazepines, opioids, zolpidem, and antihistamines given since admission
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Sedatives are a common iatrogenic cause of new somnolence in cirrhosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask the exact time of the last drink and examine for withdrawal signs: tremor, diaphoresis, tachycardia (CIWA-Ar)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: One withdrawal-assessment construct; the reported abstinence should be verified

reference_targets_freetext.item: Focal neurologic screen: Pronator drift, gaze deviation, pupils
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Excludes a focal lesion such as subdural hematoma in a coagulopathic patient

off_bedside_acceptable: head CT if fall or focal deficit
should_not_recommend: Empiric benzodiazepine for presumed withdrawal in a somnolent patient without CIWA-Ar signs
Escalating lactulose as the only action without examining for SBP, GI bleeding, or a sedative on the MAR
Withholding the abdominal examination and paracentesis because he is 'just encephalopathic'

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: last drink 3 weeks ago -> last drink the morning of admission (~36 h ago) (single swap: alcohol timing)
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 58M alcohol cirrhosis admitted yesterday for ascites, last drink morning of admission, tonight somnolent, oriented to person only, HR 78, afebrile
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Withdrawal and Wernicke encephalopathy rise: the time-of-last-drink/CIWA-Ar item and examination for ophthalmoplegia, nystagmus, and gait ataxia become must_have; Asterixis, Abdominal tenderness (SBP), and Digital rectal examination (DRE) for melena remain must_have; the melena question, the constipation/lactulose question, and Medication review (MAR) remain should-still-include.
